20.6.17.m: Śālīki says: right inside, towards that quarter.

20.6.17.s: kṛṣṇājinasyāstaraṇa iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano 'visṛjann etat karma kuryāt kṛṣṇājināvadhavanād āstaraṇāt |
20.6.17.d: कृष्णाजिनस्यास्तरण इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो ऽविसृजन्न् एतत् कर्म कुर्यात् कृष्णाजिनावधवनाद् आस्तरणात् ।
20.6.17.m: As to spreading the black antelope skin: Baudhāyana said: without letting go he should perform this action from the shaking out of the black antelope skin up to the spreading;
so from the placing of the mortar up to the pouring in of the [grains] for the cake;
so from the setting down of the pestle up to the harnessing and sweeping together;

20.6.17.s: evaṃ prastara ā srucām̐ sādanāt | evam abhryādānād ā khananāt |
20.6.17.d: एवं प्रस्तर आ स्रुचाँ सादनात् । एवम् अभ्र्यादानाद् आ खननात् ।
20.6.17.m: so from the grass bundle up to the placing of the ladles; so from the taking of the spade up to the digging;

20.6.17.s: evam audumbaryābhihomāt | evaṃ yūpa ā parivyayaṇād iti
20.6.17.d: एवम् औदुम्बर्याभिहोमात् । एवं यूप आ परिव्ययणाद् इति
20.6.17.m: so from the libation over the audumbarī pillar; so from the sacrificial post up to the tying around.

20.6.17.s: yathopapādam evaitāni karmāṇi kuryād iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.6.17.d: यथोपपादम् एवैतानि कर्माणि कुर्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.6.17.m: Śālīki says: he should perform these actions just as they arise.

20.7.17.s: puroḍāśīyānām āvapana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya pañca muṣṭīn pañcāvattinām āvaped iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.7.17.d: पुरोडाशीयानाम् आवपन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य पञ्च मुष्टीन् पञ्चावत्तिनाम् आवपेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.7.17.m: As to the pouring in of the [grains] for the cake: [this is] the sūtra of Baudhāyana. Śālīki says: he should pour in five handfuls for those who take five portions.
"He strikes together loudly the millstone and the upper stone with the sounding-stone": [this is] the sūtra of Baudhāyana.

20.7.17.s: śūrpasyopohana iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanas tūṣṇīm̐ śūrpam upohet
20.7.17.d: शूर्पस्योपोहन इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनस् तूष्णीँ शूर्पम् उपोहेत्
20.7.17.m: As to pushing underneath the winnowing-basket: [this is] the sūtra of Śālīki. On this matter Baudhāyana said: he should push the winnowing-basket underneath silently.

20.7.17.s: samas tenaivāsmin mantreṇa puroḍāśīyānudvapet | varṣavṛddham asi prati tvā varṣavṛddhaṃ vettu | iti ||
20.7.17.d: समस् तेनैवास्मिन् मन्त्रेण पुरोडाशीयानुद्वपेत् । वर्षवृद्धम् असि प्रति त्वा वर्षवृद्धं वेत्तु । इति ॥
20.7.17.m: With this very same mantra he should pour the [grains] for the cake into it: "You are rain-grown"; "May the rain-grown recognize you."

20.7.18.m: "Then having turned towards the north, he winnows": [this is] the sūtra of Baudhāyana.

20.7.18.s: yāṃ kāṃ cid diśam abhi paryāvṛtya parāpunātīti śālīkiḥ ||
20.7.18.d: यां कां चिद् दिशम् अभि पर्यावृत्य परापुनातीति शालीकिः ॥
20.7.18.m: "Turning around toward whichever direction, he winnows away," says Śālīki.

20.7.18.s: tuṣāṇāṃ nirasana iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano 'ta eva yāvan mātrān upahatya kṛṣṇājinasya grīvāta upavapet | rakṣasāṃ bhāgo 'si | ity athodakam upaspṛśed iti ||
20.7.18.d: तुषाणां निरसन इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो ऽत एव यावन् मात्रान् उपहत्य कृष्णाजिनस्य ग्रीवात उपवपेत् । रक्षसां भागो ऽसि । इत्य् अथोदकम् उपस्पृशेद् इति ॥
20.7.18.m: [As to the question:] 'At the throwing away of the chaff': The sūtra is Śālīki's. Here Baudhāyana used to say: Taking up just as much as [appropriate] from here, he should pour it out near the neck of the black antelope skin with 'Thou art the portion of the Rakṣases', and then touch water.
[As to the question:] 'At the spreading out again of the black antelope skin': The sūtra is that of the two teachers;
"With its neck pointing east, with the hair side uppermost," says Aupamanyava.

20.7.18.s: peṣaṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ prāṇāya tvā | iti prācīṃ prohet | apānāya tvā | iti pratīcīm | vyānāya tvā | iti tiraścīṃ karṣet |
20.7.18.d: पेषण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः प्राणाय त्वा । इति प्राचीं प्रोहेत् । अपानाय त्वा । इति प्रतीचीम् । व्यानाय त्वा । इति तिरश्चीं कर्षेत् ।
20.7.18.m: [As to the question:] 'At the grinding': The sūtra is Śālīki's. Here Baudhāyana used to say: He should push [the lower millstone] forward to the east with 'For prāṇa thee'; backward to the west with 'For apāna thee'; crosswise he should drag it with 'For vyāna thee';

20.7.18.s: atha prācīṃ prohet | dīrghām anu prasitim āyuṣe dhām iti
20.7.18.d: अथ प्राचीं प्रोहेत् । दीर्घाम् अनु प्रसितिम् आयुषे धाम् इति
20.7.18.m: then he should push it forward to the east with 'Along the long continuous path I place thee for life';

20.7.18.s: kṛṣṇājine piṣṭāni praskandayet | devo vaḥ savitā hiraṇyapāṇiḥ pratigṛhṇātu | iti ||
20.7.18.d: कृष्णाजिने पिष्टानि प्रस्कन्दयेत् । देवो वः सविता हिरण्यपाणिः प्रतिगृह्णातु । इति ॥
20.7.18.m: he should cause the flour to fall onto the black antelope skin with 'May the divine Savitar, golden-handed, receive you.'

20.8.18.s: naikacarau dhṛṣṭer ādānaṃ vidyate na bahuṣv iti śālīkis | atroha smāha baudhāyana ādita eva dhṛṣṭim ādadīta dhṛṣṭir asi brahma yaccha | iti
20.8.18.d: नैकचरौ धृष्टेर् आदानं विद्यते न बहुष्व् इति शालीकिस् । अत्रोह स्माह बौधायन आदित एव धृष्टिम् आददीत धृष्टिर् असि ब्रह्म यच्छ । इति
20.8.18.m: "Taking of the poker is not found in an offering having one caru nor in ones having many," says Śālīki. Here Baudhāyana used to say: From the very beginning he should take the poker with 'A poker art thou; grant sacred prayer';

20.8.18.s: gārhapatyam abhimantrayeta | apāgne 'gnim āmādaṃ jahi | iti
20.8.18.d: गार्हपत्यम् अभिमन्त्रयेत । अपाग्ने ऽग्निम् आमादं जहि । इति
20.8.18.m: he should address the gārhapatya with 'O Agni, drive away the fire that eats raw meat';

20.8.18.s: niṣkravyādam̐ sedha | iti dakṣiṇāṅgāraṃ nirasyet | athānyān kalpayet | ā devayajaṃ vaha | iti
20.8.18.d: निष्क्रव्यादँ सेध । इति दक्षिणाङ्गारं निरस्येत् । अथान्यान् कल्पयेत् । आ देवयजं वह । इति
20.8.18.m: he should cast away the south ember with 'Expel the flesh-eating one'; then he should arrange the others with 'Bring hither that which offers to the gods';

20.8.18.s: teṣu carusthālīm adhiśrayet | dhruvāsi pṛthivīṃ dṛm̐hāyur dṛm̐ha prajāṃ dṛm̐ha sajātān asmai yajamānāya paryūha | iti |
20.8.18.d: तेषु चरुस्थालीम् अधिश्रयेत् । ध्रुवासि पृथिवीं दृँहायुर् दृँह प्रजां दृँह सजातान् अस्मै यजमानाय पर्यूह । इति ।
20.8.18.m: on them he should set the caru pot with 'Firm art thou; strengthen the earth, strengthen life, strengthen offspring; surround this sacrificer with his kinsmen';

20.8.19.s: athaināṃ pradakṣiṇam aṅgāraiḥ paricinuyāt | nirdagdham̐ rakṣas | girdagdhā arātayas | iti
20.8.19.d: अथैनां प्रदक्षिणम् अङ्गारैः परिचिनुयात् । निर्दग्धँ रक्षस् । गिर्दग्धा अरातयस् । इति
20.8.19.m: then he should arrange embers clockwise around it with 'Burnt is the Rakṣas', 'Burnt are the enemies';

20.8.19.s: sa evam eva sarvāś carusthālīr adhiśrayed iti ||
20.8.19.d: स एवम् एव सर्वाश् चरुस्थालीर् अधिश्रयेद् इति ॥
20.8.19.m: "he should set on all the caru pots in this very manner."

20.8.19.s: carumukheṣv iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyana ādita eva dhṛṣṭim ādadīta
20.8.19.d: चरुमुखेष्व् इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायन आदित एव धृष्टिम् आददीत
20.8.19.m: [As to the question:] 'In [offerings] having caru as the principal': Baudhāyana used to say: From the very beginning he should take the poker;

20.8.19.s: mukhyād eva bhakṣān sādhayed iti | atro ha smāha śālīkiḥ kapālasaṃyojane khalu dhṛṣṭer ādānaṃ bhavati
20.8.19.d: मुख्याद् एव भक्षान् साधयेद् इति । अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिः कपालसंयोजने खलु धृष्टेर् आदानं भवति
20.8.19.m: "from the principal alone he should prepare the portions." Here Śālīki used to say: Indeed, the taking of the poker occurs at the joining of the potsherds;
he should take the poker just when about to place the potsherds;
"from the cake alone he should prepare the portions."

20.8.19.s: kapālānām upadhāna iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāhaupamanyavo yathāmnāyaṃ khalv asyaivaṃ kapālāny upahitāni bhavanti
20.8.19.d: कपालानाम् उपधान इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवो यथाम्नायं खल्व् अस्यैवं कपालान्य् उपहितानि भवन्ति
20.8.19.m: [As to the question:] 'At the placing of the potsherds': The sūtra is that of the two teachers. Here Aupamanyava used to say: Truly his potsherds are placed according to the sacred text;

20.8.19.s: ya evaiṣo 'ṅgārādhivartato mantras taṃ prathamaṃ kapālpodhānānāṃ kuryād atha tūṣṇīm aṅgāram adhivartayed iti |
20.8.19.d: य एवैषो ऽङ्गाराधिवर्ततो मन्त्रस् तं प्रथमं कपाल्पोधानानां कुर्याद् अथ तूष्णीम् अङ्गारम् अधिवर्तयेद् इति ।
20.8.19.m: that mantra which belongs to rolling the ember over, he should make it the first of the placing of potsherds, and then silently roll an ember over.

20.8.19.s: ekakapāle dvikapāla iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano yadi caikakapālo yadi ca dvikapālaḥ sarvair enaṃ kapālam antrair upadadhyād iti |
20.8.19.d: एककपाले द्विकपाल इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो यदि चैककपालो यदि च द्विकपालः सर्वैर् एनं कपालम् अन्त्रैर् उपदध्याद् इति ।
20.8.19.m: [As to the question:] 'In [the case of a cake on] one potsherd or two potsherds': Baudhāyana used to say: Whether it is on one potsherd or on two potsherds, he should place it with all the potsherd mantras.

20.8.19.s: atro ha smāha śālīkir yathādhikaraṇam eva kapālāny upadadhyāt |
20.8.19.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् यथाधिकरणम् एव कपालान्य् उपदध्यात् ।
20.8.19.m: On this matter, Śālīki indeed said: he should set down the potsherds just according to their arrangement;

20.8.19.s: na tu yogābhyūhau gamayet tapanamantraṃ cātra brūyāt | bhṛgūṇām aṅgirasāṃ tapasā tapyasva tapyethāṃ tapyadhvam iti ||
20.8.19.d: न तु योगाभ्यूहौ गमयेत् तपनमन्त्रं चात्र ब्रूयात् । भृगूणाम् अङ्गिरसां तपसा तप्यस्व तप्येथां तप्यध्वम् इति ॥
20.8.19.m: he should not, however, bring about their joining and covering with embers, and he should recite the heating mantra here: "Burn through the heat of the Bhṛgus, of the Aṅgirases! Burn both of you! Burn all of you!"

20.8.20.s: kapālānāṃ yoga iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāhaupamanyava etair evāsyaitāni mantrair yuktāni yair upahitāni bhavanti |
20.8.20.d: कपालानां योग इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यव एतैर् एवास्यैतानि मन्त्रैर् युक्तानि यैर् उपहितानि भवन्ति ।
20.8.20.m: Regarding the joining of the potsherds: The rule is that of the two teachers. On this matter, Aupamanyava indeed said: they are joined for him through these very mantras by which they are set down;
then the other [formula] should be simply the releasing mantra.

20.8.20.s: madantīnām adhiśrayaṇa iti || tiraḥ pavitram apa ānīyādhiśrayed iti baudhāyanas |
20.8.20.d: मदन्तीनाम् अधिश्रयण इति ॥ तिरः पवित्रम् अप आनीयाधिश्रयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.8.20.m: Regarding placing the boiling water [on the fire]: Having poured the water across the purifier, he should place it [on the fire], said Baudhāyana;
as it happens to occur, said Śālīki.

20.8.20.s: saṃyavana iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ praṇītābhyaḥ sruveṇopahatyāpa ānayet |
20.8.20.d: संयवन इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः प्रणीताभ्यः स्रुवेणोपहत्याप आनयेत् ।
20.8.20.m: Regarding mixing [the flour with water]: The rule is that of Śālīki. On this matter, Baudhāyana indeed said: drawing water from the praṇītā waters with the sruva ladle, he should pour it;

20.8.20.s: evaṃ madantībhyas tā ubhayīr ānīyamānāḥ pratimantrayeta sam āpo adbhir agmata | iti ||
20.8.20.d: एवं मदन्तीभ्यस् ता उभयीर् आनीयमानाः प्रतिमन्त्रयेत सम् आपो अद्भिर् अग्मत । इति ॥
20.8.20.m: likewise from the boiling water; while both are being poured, he should accompany them with the mantra: "The waters have met with the waters."

20.8.20.s: vyabhimarśa iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano vyabhimṛśed evaikahavis |
20.8.20.d: व्यभिमर्श इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो व्यभिमृशेद् एवैकहविस् ।
20.8.20.m: Regarding touching [the oblations] separately: Baudhāyana indeed said: he should touch even a single oblation separately;

20.8.20.s: evaṃ nānābījānīti | atro ha smāha śālīkiḥ sam̐sargāt khalu vyabhimarśo jāyate
20.8.20.d: एवं नानाबीजानीति । अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिः सँसर्गात् खलु व्यभिमर्शो जायते
20.8.20.m: likewise [oblations of] various seeds. On this matter, Śālīki said: touching separately arises, indeed, from mixing;
he should not touch oblations that are not being mixed together, nor a single oblation;
for what separate touching could there be of various seeds?

20.8.20.s: ājyasya nirvapaṇ iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | ākhyātaṃ baudhāyanasya |
20.8.20.d: आज्यस्य निर्वपण् इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । आख्यातं बौधायनस्य ।
20.8.20.m: Regarding the pouring out of the clarified butter: The rule is that of Śālīki; the view of Baudhāyana has been stated.

20.8.21.s: atro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ sarvāṇyeva havīm̐ṣi pariniṣṭhāpyājyaṃ nirvaped iti ||
20.8.21.d: अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवः सर्वाण्येव हवीँषि परिनिष्ठाप्याज्यं निर्वपेद् इति ॥
20.8.21.m: On this matter, Aupamanyava indeed said: having completely finished all the oblations, he should pour out the clarified butter.

20.8.21.s: āpyaninayana iti || jaghanena gārhapatyam āpyebhyo ninayed iti baudhāyanas |
20.8.21.d: आप्यनिनयन इति ॥ जघनेन गार्हपत्यम् आप्येभ्यो निनयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.8.21.m: Regarding pouring out [water] for the Āpyas: Behind the gārhapatya fire he should pour out [water] for the Āpyas, said Baudhāyana;

20.8.21.s: agreṇātihāyeti śālīkis | agreṇa vā jaghanena vety aupamanyavaḥ ||
20.8.21.d: अग्रेणातिहायेति शालीकिस् । अग्रेण वा जघनेन वेत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
20.8.21.m: having stepped across in front, said Śālīki; either in front or behind, said Aupamanyava.

20.9.21.s: sphyasya sam̐śāna iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano ya eṣa sphyasyodasano mantras taṃ prathamam̐ sam̐śyanānāṃ kuryād atha tūṣṇīm̐ sphyam udasyed iti ||
20.9.21.d: स्फ्यस्य सँशान इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो य एष स्फ्यस्योदसनो मन्त्रस् तं प्रथमँ सँश्यनानां कुर्याद् अथ तूष्णीँ स्फ्यम् उदस्येद् इति ॥
20.9.21.m: Regarding the sharpening of the wooden sword: The rule is that of Śālīki. On this matter, Baudhāyana indeed said: the formula that belongs to the tossing away of the wooden sword, he should make that the first of the sharpenings, and then toss away the wooden sword silently.

20.9.21.s: vedyai parigrahaṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ śroṇiṃ prathamāṃ parigṛhṇīyād atha dakṣiṇam am̐sam athottaram iti
20.9.21.d: वेद्यै परिग्रहण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः श्रोणिं प्रथमां परिगृह्णीयाद् अथ दक्षिणम् अँसम् अथोत्तरम् इति
20.9.21.m: Regarding the enclosing of the altar: The rule is that of Śālīki. On this matter, Baudhāyana indeed said: he should enclose the southern hip first, then the right shoulder, then the left [shoulder];

20.9.21.s: purastād evaināṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ parigṛhṇīyād ity aupanyavaḥ ||
20.9.21.d: पुरस्ताद् एवैनां प्रदक्षिणं परिगृह्णीयाद् इत्य् औपन्यवः ॥
20.9.21.m: he should enclose it clockwise right from the east, said Aupamanyava.

20.9.22.s: yoyupana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya caturthena yoyupitvā pañcamenodgṛhṇīyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.9.22.d: योयुपन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य चतुर्थेन योयुपित्वा पञ्चमेनोद्गृह्णीयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.9.22.m: Regarding levelling: The rule is that of Baudhāyana; having levelled with the fourth [formula], he should raise [the wooden sword] with the fifth, said Śālīki.

20.9.22.s: prokṣaṇīnām āsādana iti || sphyasya vartmann upaninīyāsādayed iti baudhāyanas |
20.9.22.d: प्रोक्षणीनाम् आसादन इति ॥ स्फ्यस्य वर्त्मन्न् उपनिनीयासादयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.9.22.m: Regarding the placing down of the sprinkling waters: Having poured [water] along the track of the wooden sword, he should place them down, said Baudhāyana;
without pouring [it] at all, said Śālīki.

20.9.22.s: idhmābarhiṣor upasādana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | uttaram idhmam iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.9.22.d: इध्माबर्हिषोर् उपसादन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । उत्तरम् इध्मम् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.9.22.m: Regarding the placing near of the kindling wood and the sacrificial grass: The rule is that of Baudhāyana; the kindling wood should be to the north, said Śālīki.

20.10.22.s: vedaparivāsaneṣv iti || pañcadhā vibhajya srucaḥ saṃmṛjed iti baudhāyanaḥ
20.10.22.d: वेदपरिवासनेष्व् इति ॥ पञ्चधा विभज्य स्रुचः संमृजेद् इति बौधायनः
20.10.22.m: Regarding the clippings of the broom: Having divided [them] into five parts, he should wipe the ladles, said Baudhāyana;
with all [the clippings together], repeatedly touching water, said Śālīki.
Regarding the wiping of the vessel for the prāśitra portion: The rule is that of Baudhāyana;

20.10.22.s: tūṣṇīm̐ saṃmṛjed iti śālīkis | na saṃmṛjed ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
20.10.22.d: तूष्णीँ संमृजेद् इति शालीकिस् । न संमृजेद् इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
20.10.22.m: he should wipe it silently, said Śālīki; he should not wipe it, said Aupamanyava.

20.10.22.s: sruksaṃmārjanānām anupraharaṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano 'dbhir abhyukṣyāsaṃcara udasyed utkare vā |
20.10.22.d: स्रुक्संमार्जनानाम् अनुप्रहरण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो ऽद्भिर् अभ्युक्ष्यासंचर उदस्येद् उत्करे वा ।
20.10.22.m: Regarding throwing after of the ladle-cleaners: The rule is that of Śālīki. On this matter, Baudhāyana indeed said: having sprinkled them with water, he should throw them in the untrodden space or on the rubbish heap;
likewise the cords of the kindling wood.

20.10.22.s: patnīnām̐ saṃnahana iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyana ekaikām āsām̐ saṃnahyed ekaikāṃ gārhapatyam īkṣayed ekaikām ājyam avekṣayed iti |
20.10.22.d: पत्नीनाँ संनहन इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायन एकैकाम् आसाँ संनह्येद् एकैकां गार्हपत्यम् ईक्षयेद् एकैकाम् आज्यम् अवेक्षयेद् इति ।
20.10.22.m: Regarding girding the wives: Baudhāyana indeed said: he should gird each one of them, make each one look at the gārhapatya fire, and make each one gaze at the clarified butter.

20.10.22.s: atro ha smāha śālīkiḥ sakṛd evaināḥ sarvāḥ saṃnahyed ekaikāṃ gārhapatyam īkṣayed ekaikām ājyam avekṣayed iti |
20.10.22.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिः सकृद् एवैनाः सर्वाः संनह्येद् एकैकां गार्हपत्यम् ईक्षयेद् एकैकाम् आज्यम् अवेक्षयेद् इति ।
20.10.22.m: On this matter, Śālīki said: he should gird them all at once, make each one look at the gārhapatya fire, and make each one gaze at the clarified butter.

20.10.22.s: atro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ sakṛd evaināḥ sarvāḥ saṃnahyet sakṛd gārhapatyam īkṣayed ekaikām ājyam avekṣayed iti |
20.10.22.d: अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवः सकृद् एवैनाः सर्वाः संनह्येत् सकृद् गार्हपत्यम् ईक्षयेद् एकैकाम् आज्यम् अवेक्षयेद् इति ।
20.10.22.m: On this matter, Aupamanyava indeed said: he should gird them all at once, make them look at the gārhapatya fire once, and make each one gaze at the clarified butter.

20.10.23.s: ekaikām evāsām̐ sarveṇasarveṇa karmaṇā parinistiṣṭhed ity aupamanyavīputraḥ ||
20.10.23.d: एकैकाम् एवासाँ सर्वेणसर्वेण कर्मणा परिनिस्तिष्ठेद् इत्य् औपमन्यवीपुत्रः ॥
20.10.23.m: He should carry through each one of them with the whole ritual action, said Aupamanyavīputra.

20.10.23.s: granthikaraṇa iti || avācīnapāśam ūrdhvanirmocanam ity ācāryayos |
20.10.23.d: ग्रन्थिकरण इति ॥ अवाचीनपाशम् ऊर्ध्वनिर्मोचनम् इत्य् आचार्ययोस् ।
20.10.23.m: Regarding making the knot: With the loop pointing downward and the untying upward, said the two teachers;

20.10.23.s: ūrdhvapāśam avācīnanirmocanam iti dīrghavātsyas | evam iva hi prajāḥ prajāyanta iti ||
20.10.23.d: ऊर्ध्वपाशम् अवाचीननिर्मोचनम् इति दीर्घवात्स्यस् । एवम् इव हि प्रजाः प्रजायन्त इति ॥
20.10.23.m: with the loop pointing upward and the untying downward, said Dīrghavātsya; for in this very manner creatures are born.

20.10.23.s: patnyām avidyamānāyām iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano yajamānāyatana āsīno yajamāna evaitān mantrān nigaded iti |
20.10.23.d: पत्न्याम् अविद्यमानायाम् इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो यजमानायतन आसीनो यजमान एवैतान् मन्त्रान् निगदेद् इति ।
20.10.23.m: When a wife is not present: Baudhāyana indeed said: seated in the seat of the sacrificer, the sacrificer alone should recite these mantras.

20.10.23.s: atro ha smāha śālīkiḥ patnīsaṃyojakāḥ khalv ete mantrā dṛṣṭā bhavanti
20.10.23.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिः पत्नीसंयोजकाः खल्व् एते मन्त्रा दृष्टा भवन्ति
20.10.23.m: On this matter, Śālīki indeed said: these mantras are seen to connect with the wife;
in her absence, he should not heed them at all.

20.10.23.s: athainām ājyam avekṣayatīti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ patnyā tad avekṣitam upayacchīta tejo 'si | iti |
20.10.23.d: अथैनाम् आज्यम् अवेक्षयतीति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः पत्न्या तद् अवेक्षितम् उपयच्छीत तेजो ऽसि । इति ।
20.10.23.m: Regarding "Then he makes her gaze at the clarified butter": The rule is that of Śālīki. On this matter, Baudhāyana indeed said: he should take hold of that which has been gazed upon by the wife, with: "You are brilliance;"

20.10.23.s: athainac chakalenopayatya haret | tejo 'nu prehi | iti |
20.10.23.d: अथैनच् छकलेनोपयत्य हरेत् । तेजो ऽनु प्रेहि । इति ।
20.10.23.m: then, having supported it with a wood splinter, he should carry it, with: "Follow after brilliance;"

20.10.23.s: athainad āhavanīye 'dhiśrayet | agnis te tejo mā vinait | iti |
20.10.23.d: अथैनद् आहवनीये ऽधिश्रयेत् । अग्निस् ते तेजो मा विनैत् । इति ।
20.10.23.m: then he should place it on the āhavanīya fire, with: "May fire not take away your brilliance;"

20.10.23.s: athainad dhṛtvottareṇa prokṣaṇīḥ sādayitvāvekṣitvotpunuyād ājyavatībhyāṃ prokṣaṇīr iti ||
20.10.23.d: अथैनद् धृत्वोत्तरेण प्रोक्षणीः सादयित्वावेक्षित्वोत्पुनुयाद् आज्यवतीभ्यां प्रोक्षणीर् इति ॥
20.10.23.m: then, having carried it and placed it north of the sprinkling waters, having gazed at it, he should purify the sprinkling waters with [the two blades] containing clarified butter.

20.10.23.s: ājyasyāvekṣaṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya sarvair evāvekṣitam ājyam utpunuyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.10.23.d: आज्यस्यावेक्षण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य सर्वैर् एवावेक्षितम् आज्यम् उत्पुनुयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.10.23.m: Regarding gazing at the clarified butter: The rule is that of Baudhāyana; he should purify the clarified butter once it has been gazed at by all, said Śālīki.

20.10.24.s: ājyagrahāṇāṃ grahaṇa iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano 'dhvaryur evobhayair mantrair gṛhṇīyāt pauroḍāśikaiś ca yājamānaiś ca
20.10.24.d: आज्यग्रहाणां ग्रहण इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो ऽध्वर्युर् एवोभयैर् मन्त्रैर् गृह्णीयात् पौरोडाशिकैश् च याजमानैश् च
20.10.24.m: Regarding drawing the ladles of clarified butter: Baudhāyana indeed said: the adhvaryu priest alone should draw with both mantras—those belonging to the cake-offering and those belonging to the sacrificer;
the sacrificer should accompany with the mantras belonging to the sacrificer.

20.10.24.s: atro ha smāha śālīkir adhvaryur evobhayair mantrair gṛhṇīyāt pauroḍāśikaiś ca yājamānaiś ca
20.10.24.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् अध्वर्युर् एवोभयैर् मन्त्रैर् गृह्णीयात् पौरोडाशिकैश् च याजमानैश् च
20.10.24.m: On this matter, Śālīki indeed said: the adhvaryu priest alone should draw with both mantras—those belonging to the cake-offering and those belonging to the sacrificer;
the sacrificer should not accompany with the mantras belonging to the sacrificer.

20.10.24.s: atro ha smāhaupamanyavo yathāpi pauroḍāśikā mantrā nābhinivartanta evam evāpi yājamānā mantrā nābhinivarterann iti ||
20.10.24.d: अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवो यथापि पौरोडाशिका मन्त्रा नाभिनिवर्तन्त एवम् एवापि याजमाना मन्त्रा नाभिनिवर्तेरन्न् इति ॥
20.10.24.m: On this matter, Aupamanyava indeed said: just as the mantras belonging to the cake-offering are not repeated, so also the mantras belonging to the sacrificer should not be repeated.

20.10.24.s: idhmābarhiṣaḥ prokṣaṇa iti || tristrir ekaikaṃ prokṣed iti baudhāyanaḥ
20.10.24.d: इध्माबर्हिषः प्रोक्षण इति ॥ त्रिस्त्रिर् एकैकं प्रोक्षेद् इति बौधायनः
20.10.24.m: Regarding sprinkling the kindling wood and sacrificial grass: He should sprinkle each one three times, said Baudhāyana;

20.11.24.s: barhiṣaḥ prokṣaṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanas tiṣṭhan dive tvā | ity agrāṇi prokṣet prahvas | antarikṣāya tvā | iti madhyāny upaviśya pṛthivyai tvā | iti mūlāni
20.11.24.d: बर्हिषः प्रोक्षण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनस् तिष्ठन् दिवे त्वा । इत्य् अग्राणि प्रोक्षेत् प्रह्वस् । अन्तरिक्षाय त्वा । इति मध्यान्य् उपविश्य पृथिव्यै त्वा । इति मूलानि
20.11.24.m: Regarding sprinkling the sacrificial grass: The rule is that of Śālīki. On this matter, Baudhāyana indeed said: standing, he should sprinkle the tips with "For the sky, you;" bent forward, the middles with "For the intermediate space, you;" sitting down, the roots with "For the earth, you;"

20.11.24.s: saha srucā purastāt pratyañcaṃ granthiṃ pratyukṣyātiśiṣṭāḥ prokṣāṇīr ninayed dakṣiṇāyai śroṇer ottarāyai śroṇeḥ svadhā pitṛbhyas | ūrg bhava barhiṣadbhyas | ūrjā pṛthivīṃ gacchata | iti ||
20.11.24.d: सह स्रुचा पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्चं ग्रन्थिं प्रत्युक्ष्यातिशिष्टाः प्रोक्षाणीर् निनयेद् दक्षिणायै श्रोणेर् ओत्तरायै श्रोणेः स्वधा पितृभ्यस् । ऊर्ग् भव बर्हिषद्भ्यस् । ऊर्जा पृथिवीं गच्छत । इति ॥
20.11.24.m: having sprinkled back the knot from east to west together with the ladle, he should pour out the remaining sprinkling waters from the southern hip up to the northern hip with: "Svadhā to the fathers!", "Become refreshment for those seated on the sacrificial grass!", "Go to the earth with refreshment!"

20.11.25.s: sruca udūhana iti || agreṇātmānam udīcīm udūhed iti baudhāyanas |
20.11.25.d: स्रुच उदूहन इति ॥ अग्रेणात्मानम् उदीचीम् उदूहेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.11.25.m: Regarding pushing forward the ladles: He should push them forward northward in front of himself, said Baudhāyana;
he should push them forward northward behind himself, said Śālīki.

20.11.25.s: prastare pavitre apisṛjati yajamāne prāṇāpānau dadhāmi | iti vā tūṣṇīṃ veti ||
20.11.25.d: प्रस्तरे पवित्रे अपिसृजति यजमाने प्राणापानौ दधामि । इति वा तूष्णीं वेति ॥
20.11.25.m: Regarding the putting of the two purifiers upon the grass bundle, [with the mantra,] “In the sacrificer I place the in-breath and the out-breath,” or silently.
The first procedure is that of Baudhāyana; the latter is that of Śālīki.

20.11.25.s: taṃ yajamānāya vā brahmaṇe vā prayacchatīti || pūrvaḥ kalpaḥ śālīker uttaro baudhāyanasya ||
20.11.25.d: तं यजमानाय वा ब्रह्मणे वा प्रयच्छतीति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पः शालीकेर् उत्तरो बौधायनस्य ॥
20.11.25.m: Regarding [the instruction,] “He hands it either to the sacrificer or to the Brahman [priest]”: the first procedure is that of Śālīki; the latter is that of Baudhāyana.

20.11.25.s: śulbasyāyātana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya śulba visrasya dakṣiṇe vedyante stṛṇīyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.11.25.d: शुल्बस्यायातन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य शुल्ब विस्रस्य दक्षिणे वेद्यन्ते स्तृणीयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.11.25.m: Regarding the resting place of the grass cord: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana; having untied the grass cord, he should spread it out at the southern edge of the altar, so says Śālīki.

20.11.25.s: vedyai staraṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | ata evaināṃ prācīṃ dhātuśa stṛṇīyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.11.25.d: वेद्यै स्तरण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । अत एवैनां प्राचीं धातुश स्तृणीयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.11.25.m: Regarding the strewing of the altar: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana; he should strew it eastward from here layer by layer, so says Śālīki.

20.11.25.s: paridhīnāṃ paridhāna iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano 'dhyasyed dakṣiṇam upohed uttaram iti |
20.11.25.d: परिधीनां परिधान इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो ऽध्यस्येद् दक्षिणम् उपोहेद् उत्तरम् इति ।
20.11.25.m: Regarding the laying around of the enclosing sticks: Baudhāyana indeed used to say, “He should overlap the southern one, and push in the northern one.”
“He should lay them around so that they touch end to end,” so says Śālīki.

20.11.25.s: atha sūryeṇa purastāt paridadhātīti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | āhavanīyam evaitena yajuṣopatiṣṭheteti śālīkiḥ ||
20.11.25.d: अथ सूर्येण पुरस्तात् परिदधातीति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । आहवनीयम् एवैतेन यजुषोपतिष्ठेतेति शालीकिः ॥
20.11.25.m: Regarding [the rule,] “Then he encloses in front with [the formula mentioning] Sūrya”: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana; with this formula he should merely revere the āhavanīya fire, so says Śālīki.

20.11.25.s: ūrdhve samidhāv ādadhātīti | sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | ūrdhve evaine abhyādhāyānatipātayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.11.25.d: ऊर्ध्वे समिधाव् आदधातीति । सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । ऊर्ध्वे एवैने अभ्याधायानतिपातयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.11.25.m: Regarding [the rule,] “He places two upright kindling sticks”: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana; having placed them upright, he should not let them fall over, so says Śālīki.

20.11.26.s: vidhṛtyoḥ karaṇa iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāha dakṣiṇākāro rāthītara ubhe evaite vediṃ vyatiṣajyeyātām iti
20.11.26.d: विधृत्योः करण इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माह दक्षिणाकारो राथीतर उभे एवैते वेदिं व्यतिषज्येयाताम् इति
20.11.26.m: Regarding the making of the two dividing blades: the sūtra is that of the two teachers; but here Dakṣiṇākāra Rāthītara said, “Both of these should intertwine across the altar.”

20.11.26.s: madhyamād dhātor anantargarbhe syātām ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
20.11.26.d: मध्यमाद् धातोर् अनन्तर्गर्भे स्याताम् इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
20.11.26.m: “They should be from the middle layer, without an inner sprout,” so says Aupamanyava.

20.12.26.s: dohanapavitrasyāsādana iti || visrasya prastara āsādayed iti baudhāyanas |
20.12.26.d: दोहनपवित्रस्यासादन इति ॥ विस्रस्य प्रस्तर आसादयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.12.26.m: Regarding the placing of the milking-strainer: “He should place it upon the untied grass bundle,” so says Baudhāyana.
“Indeed upon the untied [grass bundle],” so says Śālīki.

20.12.26.s: srucām̐ sādana iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyana īṣat pratyavahatām ivopabhṛtam̐ sādayed vidhṛtībhyāṃ cainām avagṛhṇīyād iti |
20.12.26.d: स्रुचाँ सादन इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायन ईषत् प्रत्यवहताम् इवोपभृतँ सादयेद् विधृतीभ्यां चैनाम् अवगृह्णीयाद् इति ।
20.12.26.m: Regarding the placing of the ladles: Baudhāyana indeed used to say, “He should place the upabhṛt ladle slightly lowered, as it were, and restrain it with the two dividing blades.”

20.12.26.s: atro ha smāha śālīkir anupūrvā evaināḥ sādayen na copabhṛtaṃ vidhṛtībhyām avagṛhṇīyād iti ||
20.12.26.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् अनुपूर्वा एवैनाः सादयेन् न चोपभृतं विधृतीभ्याम् अवगृह्णीयाद् इति ॥
20.12.26.m: Here Śālīki said, “He should place them in order, and he should not restrain the upabhṛt ladle with the two dividing blades.”

20.12.26.s: haviṣām udvāsana iti || agreṇānudvāsitāni jaghanenodvāsitānīti baudhāyanas |
20.12.26.d: हविषाम् उद्वासन इति ॥ अग्रेणानुद्वासितानि जघनेनोद्वासितानीति बौधायनस् ।
20.12.26.m: Regarding the removing of the oblations: “Those not removed [are placed] to the front, those removed to the rear,” so says Baudhāyana.
“Those not removed to the rear, those removed to the front,” so says Śālīki.

20.12.26.s: pratyañjana iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyana ubhayāni pratyañjyāc carūṇāṃ cāśayān kāpālāni ceti
20.12.26.d: प्रत्यञ्जन इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायन उभयानि प्रत्यञ्ज्याच् चरूणां चाशयान् कापालानि चेति
20.12.26.m: Regarding anointing back: Baudhāyana indeed used to say, “He should anoint back both: the places of the caru offerings and the potsherds.”

20.12.27.s: kapālānām ādhvaryave vimoka iti || udvāsya havīm̐ṣīty atrācāryau vimuñcatas |
20.12.27.d: कपालानाम् आध्वर्यवे विमोक इति ॥ उद्वास्य हवीँषीत्य् अत्राचार्यौ विमुञ्चतस् ।
20.12.27.m: Regarding the disposal of the potsherds in the duties of the adhvaryu priest: “Having removed the oblations,” at this point the two teachers dispose of them.

20.12.27.s: bhakṣayann eva bhakṣāṇāṃ pāre kapālāni vimuñced ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
20.12.27.d: भक्षयन्न् एव भक्षाणां पारे कपालानि विमुञ्चेद् इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
20.12.27.m: “Only while consuming, at the end of the consumptions, should he dispose of the potsherds,” so says Aupamanyava.

20.12.27.s: āghārāv iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | abhīṣū iva vyatiṣaktau syātām iti śālīkiḥ
20.12.27.d: आघाराव् इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । अभीषू इव व्यतिषक्तौ स्याताम् इति शालीकिः
20.12.27.m: Regarding the two continuous libations: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana; “They should be crossed like reins,” so says Śālīki.

20.12.27.s: saṃpraiṣa iti || agnīd agnīn iti baudhāyanas | agnim agnīdh | iti śālīkis |
20.12.27.d: संप्रैष इति ॥ अग्नीद् अग्नीन् इति बौधायनस् । अग्निम् अग्नीध् । इति शालीकिस् ।
20.12.27.m: Regarding the summons: “O fire-kindler, the fires,” so says Baudhāyana; “The fire, O fire-kindler,” so says Śālīki.

20.12.27.s: agnīt paridhīm̐ś cāgniṃ ca | ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
20.12.27.d: अग्नीत् परिधीँश् चाग्निं च । इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
20.12.27.m: “O fire-kindler, the enclosing sticks and the fire,” so says Aupamanyava.

20.12.27.s: atyākramaṇa iti || savyena pradāsyann atyākrāmed dhutvāmuto dakṣiṇeneti baudhāyanas |
20.12.27.d: अत्याक्रमण इति ॥ सव्येन प्रदास्यन्न् अत्याक्रामेद् धुत्वामुतो दक्षिणेनेति बौधायनस् ।
20.12.27.m: Regarding the stepping across: “About to give [the offering], he should step across with the left foot, and having offered from there, [step back] with the right,” so says Baudhāyana.

20.12.27.s: dakṣiṇena pradāsyann atyākrāmed dhutvāmutaḥ savyeneti śālīkiḥ
20.12.27.d: दक्षिणेन प्रदास्यन्न् अत्याक्रामेद् धुत्वामुतः सव्येनेति शालीकिः
20.12.27.m: “About to give [the offering], he should step across with the right foot, and having offered from there, [step back] with the left,” so says Śālīki.

20.12.28.s: āśrāvaṇa iti || o śrāvaya | iti baudhāyanas | ā śrāvaya | iti śālīkiḥ
20.12.28.d: आश्रावण इति ॥ ओ श्रावय । इति बौधायनस् । आ श्रावय । इति शालीकिः
20.12.28.m: Regarding the call: “O śrāvaya,” so says Baudhāyana; “Ā śrāvaya,” so says Śālīki.

20.12.28.s: pravara iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyana utkara ūrdhvāgram̐ sphyaṃ nihatya pravaraṃ pravṛṇīyād atraiva ca sphyam udasyed upariṣṭāc copaspṛśed iti ||
20.12.28.d: प्रवर इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायन उत्कर ऊर्ध्वाग्रँ स्फ्यं निहत्य प्रवरं प्रवृणीयाद् अत्रैव च स्फ्यम् उदस्येद् उपरिष्टाच् चोपस्पृशेद् इति ॥
20.12.28.m: Regarding the ancestral invocation: the sūtra is that of Śālīki; here Baudhāyana said, “Having thrust the wooden sword into the rubbish heap point upwards, he should choose the ancestral invocation, and right there he should toss up the wooden sword and touch it from above.”

20.12.28.s: hotur varaṇa iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano yady asya pitā vācāryo vā jyāyān vā hotā syād upām̐śv eteṣāṃ gurūṇāṃ nāmāni gṛhṇīyād iti |
20.12.28.d: होतुर् वरण इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो यद्य् अस्य पिता वाचार्यो वा ज्यायान् वा होता स्याद् उपाँश्व् एतेषां गुरूणां नामानि गृह्णीयाद् इति ।
20.12.28.m: Regarding the choosing of the hotṛ priest: Baudhāyana indeed used to say, “If his father, teacher, or an elder should be the hotṛ priest, he should whisper the names of these elders.”

20.12.28.s: uccair eva hotur nāma gṛhṇīyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.12.28.d: उच्चैर् एव होतुर् नाम गृह्णीयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.12.28.m: “He should mention the name of the hotṛ priest aloud,” so says Śālīki.

20.13.28.s: abhikrāmaṃ juhotīti || sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ sarveṇābhikrāmet padbhyām āhutībhiḥ svareṇa |
20.13.28.d: अभिक्रामं जुहोतीति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनः सर्वेणाभिक्रामेत् पद्भ्याम् आहुतीभिः स्वरेण ।
20.13.28.m: Regarding [the rule,] “He offers while stepping forward”: Baudhāyana indeed used to say, “He should step forward in all respects: with his feet, with the oblations, and with his voice.”
“He should offer each successive libation larger and larger.”

20.13.28.s: padbhyām evābhikrāmam̐ samānatrāhutīr juhuyād iti śālīkiḥ
20.13.28.d: पद्भ्याम् एवाभिक्रामँ समानत्राहुतीर् जुहुयाद् इति शालीकिः
20.13.28.m: “Stepping forward with his feet only, he should offer the libations in the same place,” so says Śālīki.

20.13.28.s: samānatra tiṣṭhann āhutībhir evābhikrāmed ity aupamanyavaḥ
20.13.28.d: समानत्र तिष्ठन्न् आहुतीभिर् एवाभिक्रामेद् इत्य् औपमन्यवः
20.13.28.m: "Standing in the same place, one should step forward only through the oblations," says Aupamanyava.

20.13.28.s: samānatraiva tiṣṭhan pradakṣiṇam anudiśam̐ hutvā madhye svāhākāraṃ juhuyād ity āñjīgaviḥ ||
20.13.28.d: समानत्रैव तिष्ठन् प्रदक्षिणम् अनुदिशँ हुत्वा मध्ये स्वाहाकारं जुहुयाद् इत्य् आञ्जीगविः ॥
20.13.28.m: "Standing in the very same place, having offered clockwise toward each direction, one should offer the svāhā-utterance in the middle," says Āñjīgavi.

20.13.29.s: ājyabhāgayor homa iti || pūrvārdhe pratimukhaṃ prabāhug juhuyād iti baudhāyanaḥ
20.13.29.d: आज्यभागयोर् होम इति ॥ पूर्वार्धे प्रतिमुखं प्रबाहुग् जुहुयाद् इति बौधायनः
20.13.29.m: Regarding the offering of the two butter-portions: / "One should offer facing directly ahead, with arms outstretched, in the eastern half," says Baudhāyana.
"In the eastern half alone, with arms outstretched," says Śālīki.

20.13.29.s: haviṣām avadāna iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ pūrvārdhād evāgre prathamaṃ mukhyasya haviṣo 'vadyed athāparārdhāt |
20.13.29.d: हविषाम् अवदान इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनः पूर्वार्धाद् एवाग्रे प्रथमं मुख्यस्य हविषो ऽवद्येद् अथापरार्धात् ।
20.13.29.m: Regarding the cutting of the oblations: / Baudhāyana said: "One should cut first indeed from the eastern half of the principal oblation, then from the western half.

20.13.29.s: evam asya pradakṣiṇam̐ haviṣām avattaṃ bhavatīti |
20.13.29.d: एवम् अस्य प्रदक्षिणँ हविषाम् अवत्तं भवतीति ।
20.13.29.m: Thus the cutting of his oblations proceeds clockwise."

20.13.29.s: atro ha smāha śālīkir aparārdhād evāgre prathamaṃ mukhyasva haviṣo 'vadyed atha pūrvārdhāt |
20.13.29.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् अपरार्धाद् एवाग्रे प्रथमं मुख्यस्व हविषो ऽवद्येद् अथ पूर्वार्धात् ।
20.13.29.m: Here Śālīki said: "One should cut first indeed from the western half of the principal oblation, then from the eastern half.
Thus his oblations conclude toward the east."

20.13.29.s: madhyāt pūrvārdhāt paścārdhāt pañcāvattinām ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
20.13.29.d: मध्यात् पूर्वार्धात् पश्चार्धात् पञ्चावत्तिनाम् इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
20.13.29.m: "From the middle, from the eastern half, [and] from the western half, for those who make five cuttings," says Aupamanyava.

20.13.29.s: āhutīnām āyatana iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyanas trīṇy evaitāny ādiṣṭasthānāni bhavanty ājyabhāgau sviṣṭakṛt |
20.13.29.d: आहुतीनाम् आयतन इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनस् त्रीण्य् एवैतान्य् आदिष्टस्थानानि भवन्त्य् आज्यभागौ स्विष्टकृत् ।
20.13.29.m: Regarding the location of the oblations: / Baudhāyana said: "Only these three have prescribed places: the two butter-portions [and the offering to Agni] Sviṣṭakṛt.
Then one should offer the others according to space."

20.13.29.s: praṣṭīr evāhutīr juhvat pūrvārdhe sviṣṭakṛtaṃ juhuyād iti śālīkiḥ
20.13.29.d: प्रष्टीर् एवाहुतीर् जुह्वत् पूर्वार्धे स्विष्टकृतं जुहुयाद् इति शालीकिः
20.13.29.m: "Offering the oblations in a row, one should offer the [offering to Agni] Sviṣṭakṛt in the eastern half," says Śālīki.
"One should offer over the line of the ladle libation," says Aupamanyava.
"In the middle, clockwise, in the shape of a circle," says Rāthītara.

20.13.29.s: upām̐śuyājasya karaṇa iti || sūtraṃ maudgalyasya | atro ha smāha baudhāyana auṣadhasyopām̐śuyājaṃ kuryād agnīṣomīyaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vaiṣṇavam amāvāsyāyām iti |
20.13.29.d: उपाँशुयाजस्य करण इति ॥ सूत्रं मौद्गल्यस्य । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायन औषधस्योपाँशुयाजं कुर्याद् अग्नीषोमीयं पौर्णमास्यां वैष्णवम् अमावास्यायाम् इति ।
20.13.29.m: Regarding the performance of the whispered offering: / The rule is that of Maudgalya. / Here Baudhāyana said: "One should make the whispered offering of vegetable matter: dedicated to Agni-Soma on the full moon day, dedicated to Viṣṇu on the new moon day."

20.13.29.s: atro ha smāha śālīkir ājyasyopām̐śuyājaṃ kuryāt saumyaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vaiṣṇavam amāvāsyāyām iti |
20.13.29.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् आज्यस्योपाँशुयाजं कुर्यात् सौम्यं पौर्णमास्यां वैष्णवम् अमावास्यायाम् इति ।
20.13.29.m: Here Śālīki said: "One should make the whispered offering of ghee: dedicated to Soma on the full moon day, dedicated to Viṣṇu on the new moon day."

20.13.29.s: atro ha smāhaupamanyava auṣadhasyaivopām̐śuyājaṃ kuryāt sarasvataḥ paurṇamāsyām̐ sarasvatyā amāvāsyāyām iti |
20.13.29.d: अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यव औषधस्यैवोपाँशुयाजं कुर्यात् सरस्वतः पौर्णमास्याँ सरस्वत्या अमावास्यायाम् इति ।
20.13.29.m: Here Aupamanyava said: "One should make the whispered offering of vegetable matter alone: dedicated to Sarasvat on the full moon day, to Sarasvatī on the new moon day."
"On both occasions it is of ghee, dedicated to Viṣṇu," says Rāthītara.

20.13.30.s: atro ha smāha kauṇapatantriś caruś ca syād vaiṣṇavaś ca syāt svayaṃ caiva yajamānaḥ prāśnīyād iti ||
20.13.30.d: अत्रो ह स्माह कौणपतन्त्रिश् चरुश् च स्याद् वैष्णवश् च स्यात् स्वयं चैव यजमानः प्राश्नीयाद् इति ॥
20.13.30.m: Here Kauṇapatantri said: "It should be a mess of boiled rice, and it should be dedicated to Viṣṇu, and the sacrificer himself should eat it."
Regarding the increase of the fifth cutting: / "One should increase [that] of the vegetable matter," says Baudhāyana.

20.13.30.s: mekṣaṇasyānupraharaṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano na mekṣaṇanyāyena vapāśrapaṇī anuprahared iti ||
20.13.30.d: मेक्षणस्यानुप्रहरण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो न मेक्षणन्यायेन वपाश्रपणी अनुप्रहरेद् इति ॥
20.13.30.m: Regarding the throwing after of the stirring-stick: / The rule is that of Śālīki. / Here Baudhāyana said: "One should not throw after the two omentum-cooking spits according to the rule of the stirring-stick."

20.13.30.s: prāśitrasyāvadāna iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya parihariṣyann eva prāśitram avadyed iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.13.30.d: प्राशित्रस्यावदान इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य परिहरिष्यन्न् एव प्राशित्रम् अवद्येद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.13.30.m: Regarding the cutting of the prāśitra: / The rule is that of Baudhāyana. / "Just as he is about to carry it around, one should cut the prāśitra," says Śālīki.

20.13.30.s: ājyahaviṣy anvāhāryasya karaṇa iti || kuryād iti baudhāyanas |
20.13.30.d: आज्यहविष्य् अन्वाहार्यस्य करण इति ॥ कुर्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.13.30.m: Regarding the preparation of the anvāhārya cooked rice when the oblation is of ghee: / "One should prepare it," says Baudhāyana.

20.13.30.s: anvāhāryasyāsādana iti || agreṇa yajamānaṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ ca paryāhṛtya dakṣiṇasyām̐ śroṇyām āsādayed iti baudhāyanas |
20.13.30.d: अन्वाहार्यस्यासादन इति ॥ अग्रेण यजमानं च ब्रह्माणं च पर्याहृत्य दक्षिणस्याँ श्रोण्याम् आसादयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.13.30.m: Regarding the placing of the anvāhārya cooked rice: / "Having carried it around in front of the sacrificer and the brahman priest, he should place it on the southern hip [of the altar]," says Baudhāyana.

20.13.30.s: ata eva dakṣiṇasyām̐ śroṇyām iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.13.30.d: अत एव दक्षिणस्याँ श्रोण्याम् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.13.30.m: "From here itself on the southern hip," says Śālīki.

20.14.31.s: anvāhāryasyodvāsana iti || agreṇa sruca udañcam udvāsayed iti baudhāyanas |
20.14.31.d: अन्वाहार्यस्योद्वासन इति ॥ अग्रेण स्रुच उदञ्चम् उद्वासयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.14.31.m: Regarding the removal of the anvāhārya cooked rice: / "He should remove it northwards in front of the ladles," says Baudhāyana.

20.14.31.s: havirucchiṣṭānām udvāsana iti || agreṇa sruca udañcy udvāsayed iti baudhāyanas |
20.14.31.d: हविरुच्छिष्टानाम् उद्वासन इति ॥ अग्रेण स्रुच उदञ्च्य् उद्वासयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.14.31.m: Regarding the removal of the oblation-remnants: / "He should remove them northwards in front of the ladles," says Baudhāyana.

20.14.31.s: anūyājānām̐ homa iti || sūtram̐ baudhāyanasya pratīcīr evaitā āhutīḥ sam̐sthāpayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.14.31.d: अनूयाजानाँ होम इति ॥ सूत्रँ बौधायनस्य प्रतीचीर् एवैता आहुतीः सँस्थापयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.14.31.m: Regarding the offering of the after-offerings: / The rule is that of Baudhāyana. / "One should conclude these oblations turning toward the west," says Śālīki.

20.14.31.s: vājavatyor vyūhana iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano 'kṣṇayā pratīcīm upabhṛtaṃ pratyūhed adbhiś cainām̐ sam̐spṛśed iti |
20.14.31.d: वाजवत्योर् व्यूहन इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो ऽक्ष्णया प्रतीचीम् उपभृतं प्रत्यूहेद् अद्भिश् चैनाँ सँस्पृशेद् इति ।
20.14.31.m: Regarding the shifting apart of the two [ladles] with the vājavatī mantras: / Baudhāyana said: "He should push back the upabhṛt ladle diagonally toward the west and touch it with water."

20.14.31.s: atro ha smāha śālīkiḥ prācīnapuṣkare evaine vikarṣen na copabhṛtam adbhiḥ sam̐spṛśed iti ||
20.14.31.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिः प्राचीनपुष्करे एवैने विकर्षेन् न चोपभृतम् अद्भिः सँस्पृशेद् इति ॥
20.14.31.m: Here Śālīki said: "He should separate them with their bowls pointing eastwards and should not touch the upabhṛt ladle with water."

20.14.31.s: prastarasya samañjana iti || tristrir ekaikasyām̐ samañjyād iti baudhāyanaḥ
20.14.31.d: प्रस्तरस्य समञ्जन इति ॥ त्रिस्त्रिर् एकैकस्याँ समञ्ज्याद् इति बौधायनः
20.14.31.m: Regarding the anointing of the grass bundle: / "He should anoint it three times in each [ladle]," says Baudhāyana.

20.14.31.s: prastarasyānupraharaṇa iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano 'dhvaryur evobhayair mantrair anupraharet pauroḍāśikaiś ca yājamānaiś ca
20.14.31.d: प्रस्तरस्यानुप्रहरण इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो ऽध्वर्युर् एवोभयैर् मन्त्रैर् अनुप्रहरेत् पौरोडाशिकैश् च याजमानैश् च
20.14.31.m: Regarding the throwing after of the grass bundle: / Baudhāyana said: "The adhvaryu priest himself should throw it after with both sets of mantras: those belonging to the cake-offering and those belonging to the sacrificer.
The sacrificer should accompany [the action] with the mantras belonging to the sacrificer."

20.14.31.s: atro ha smāha śālīkir adhvaryur evobhayair mantrair anupraharet pauroḍāśikaiś ca yājamānaiś ca
20.14.31.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् अध्वर्युर् एवोभयैर् मन्त्रैर् अनुप्रहरेत् पौरोडाशिकैश् च याजमानैश् च
20.14.31.m: Here Śālīki said: "The adhvaryu priest himself should throw it after with both sets of mantras: those belonging to the cake-offering and those belonging to the sacrificer.
The sacrificer should not accompany [the action] with the mantras belonging to the sacrificer."

20.14.31.s: atro ha smāhaupamanyavo yathāpi pauroḍāśikā mantrā nābhivartanta evam evāpi yājamānā mantrā nābhivarterann iti ||
20.14.31.d: अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवो यथापि पौरोडाशिका मन्त्रा नाभिवर्तन्त एवम् एवापि याजमाना मन्त्रा नाभिवर्तेरन्न् इति ॥
20.14.31.m: Here Aupamanyava said: "Just as the mantras belonging to the cake-offering are not repeated, so also the mantras belonging to the sacrificer should not be repeated."

20.14.32.s: paridhīnām abhyādhāna iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya prasthāna evainān abhyādadhyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.14.32.d: परिधीनाम् अभ्याधान इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य प्रस्थान एवैनान् अभ्यादध्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.14.32.m: Regarding the placing of the enclosing sticks onto [the fire]: / The rule is that of Baudhāyana. / "He should place them onto [the fire] only at the departure [from the altar]," says Śālīki.
Regarding: 'Then he offers over them with the trickling residue': / The rule is that of Baudhāyana.

20.14.32.s: prastaraṃ caiva paridhīm̐ś cābhijuhuyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.14.32.d: प्रस्तरं चैव परिधीँश् चाभिजुहुयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.14.32.m: "He should offer over both the grass bundle and the enclosing sticks," says Śālīki.

20.14.32.s: srucor vimoka iti || pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
20.14.32.d: स्रुचोर् विमोक इति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पो बौधायनस्योत्तरः शालीकेः ॥
20.14.32.m: Regarding the unyoking of the two ladles: / The former procedure is that of Baudhāyana, the latter that of Śālīki.
Regarding the walking around of the officiating priests at the wife-offerings:

20.14.32.s: sarva evottareṇa gārhapatyaṃ parikrāmeyur iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.14.32.d: सर्व एवोत्तरेण गार्हपत्यं परिक्रामेयुर् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.14.32.m: "All should walk around to the north of the gārhapatya fire," says Śālīki.

20.15.32.s: patnīnām̐ saṃyājana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya dhrauvājyena dhvānenaiva patnīḥ saṃyājayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.15.32.d: पत्नीनाँ संयाजन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य ध्रौवाज्येन ध्वानेनैव पत्नीः संयाजयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.15.32.m: Regarding the making of the wife-offerings: / The rule is that of Baudhāyana. / "One should perform the wife-offerings with the ghee in the dhruvā ladle, in a low whisper," says Śālīki.

20.15.32.s: antardhāya devānāṃ patnīḥ saṃyājayed iti baudhāyanas |
20.15.32.d: अन्तर्धाय देवानां पत्नीः संयाजयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.15.32.m: "Having screened [them] off, one should make offerings to the wives of the gods," says Baudhāyana.
"Without screening off at all," says Śālīki.

20.15.32.s: patnīsaṃyājeṣu śamyuvākasya karaṇa iti || kuryād iti baudhāyanas |
20.15.32.d: पत्नीसंयाजेषु शम्युवाकस्य करण इति ॥ कुर्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.15.32.m: Regarding the recitation of the śamyuvāka at the wife-offerings: / "One should recite it," says Baudhāyana.

20.15.32.s: dhruvāyā āpyāyana iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyana ubhāv eva dhruvām āpyāyayetām adhvaryuś ca yajamānaś ceti |
20.15.32.d: ध्रुवाया आप्यायन इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायन उभाव् एव ध्रुवाम् आप्याययेताम् अध्वर्युश् च यजमानश् चेति ।
20.15.32.m: Regarding the swelling of the dhruvā ladle: / Baudhāyana said: "Both the adhvaryu priest and the sacrificer should swell the dhruvā ladle."

20.15.33.s: adhvaryur eva dhruvām āpyāyya samiṣṭayajur juhuyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.15.33.d: अध्वर्युर् एव ध्रुवाम् आप्याय्य समिष्टयजुर् जुहुयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.15.33.m: "The adhvaryu priest alone, having swelled the dhruvā ladle, should offer the samiṣṭayajus," says Śālīki.

20.15.33.s: samiṣṭayajuṣo homa iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāha gautamaḥ svāhā vāci | iti hutvā barhiṣo dhātūnām̐ saṃpralupya dhruvāyām̐ samajyānuprahṛtyābhijuhuyāt svāhā vāte dhāḥ svāhā | iti ||
20.15.33.d: समिष्टयजुषो होम इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माह गौतमः स्वाहा वाचि । इति हुत्वा बर्हिषो धातूनाँ संप्रलुप्य ध्रुवायाँ समज्यानुप्रहृत्याभिजुहुयात् स्वाहा वाते धाः स्वाहा । इति ॥
20.15.33.m: Regarding the offering of the samiṣṭayajus: / The rule is that of the two teachers. / Here Gautama said: "Having offered with 'Hail to Speech!', having plucked some stalks from the sacrificial grass, having anointed them in the dhruvā ladle, and having thrown them after, he should offer over [them] with 'Hail! Place [it] in the wind, hail!'"

20.16.33.m: Now we shall explain the setting up of the sacred fires.

20.16.33.s: saṃbhāreṣv iti || sūtram̐ rāthītarāṇām atro ha smāha baudhāyano nāśanihataṃ kurvīta ghorarūpam iti
20.16.33.d: संभारेष्व् इति ॥ सूत्रँ राथीतराणाम् अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो नाशनिहतं कुर्वीत घोररूपम् इति
20.16.33.m: Regarding the materials [for the fires]: / The rule is that of the Rāthītaras. / Here Baudhāyana said: "One should not use [wood] struck by lightning, [for] it has a terrible form."

20.16.33.s: na tu muñjakulāyam | na hy etasyānukhyā vijñāyata iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.16.33.d: न तु मुञ्जकुलायम् । न ह्य् एतस्यानुख्या विज्ञायत इति शालीकिः ॥
20.16.33.m: One should not, however, [use] a nest of muñja grass; / for its appearance is not known," says Śālīki.

20.16.33.s: pātrāṇāṃ karaṇa iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyanas tvaktaāsecanāni kārayed agrataḥpuṣkarāṇi |
20.16.33.d: पात्राणां करण इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनस् त्वक्तआसेचनानि कारयेद् अग्रतःपुष्कराणि ।
20.16.33.m: Regarding the fashioning of the vessels: Baudhāyana indeed used to say, “He should have the pouring spouts made on the bark side, with their bowls at the tip.”

20.16.33.s: evam asya prācīnapuṣkarāḥ srucaḥ sannā bhavantīti |
20.16.33.d: एवम् अस्य प्राचीनपुष्कराः स्रुचः सन्ना भवन्तीति ।
20.16.33.m: “Thus his ladles are placed with their bowls facing eastward.”

20.16.33.s: atro ha smāha śālīkis tvaktaāsecanāni kārayen mūlataḥpuṣkarāṇi |
20.16.33.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिस् त्वक्तआसेचनानि कारयेन् मूलतःपुष्कराणि ।
20.16.33.m: Here Śālīki said, “He should have the pouring spouts made on the bark side, with their bowls at the root.”

20.16.33.s: evam asya prācīnapuṣkarāḥ srucaḥ sannā bhavantīti
20.16.33.d: एवम् अस्य प्राचीनपुष्कराः स्रुचः सन्ना भवन्तीति
20.16.33.m: “Thus his ladles are placed with their bowls facing eastward.”

20.16.33.s: vijñāyate tasmād avācīnāgrā vanaspatayaḥ pṛthivīṃ kṣiyanti | iti ||
20.16.33.d: विज्ञायते तस्माद् अवाचीनाग्रा वनस्पतयः पृथिवीं क्षियन्ति । इति ॥
20.16.33.m: It is known [from a sacred passage]: “Therefore trees dwell upon the earth with their tops downwards.”

20.16.34.s: srucāṃ pramāṇa iti || bāhumātrāḥ syur iti baudhāyanas |
20.16.34.d: स्रुचां प्रमाण इति ॥ बाहुमात्राः स्युर् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.16.34.m: Regarding the measurement of the ladles: “They should be an arm's length,” so says Baudhāyana.

20.16.34.s: aratnimātrā iti śālīkiḥ prādeśamātrā ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
20.16.34.d: अरत्निमात्रा इति शालीकिः प्रादेशमात्रा इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
20.16.34.m: “A cubit in length,” so says Śālīki; “A span in length,” so says Aupamanyava.

20.16.34.s: srucām ākṛtivikāra iti || hastyoṣṭhyaḥ syur iti baudhāyanas |
20.16.34.d: स्रुचाम् आकृतिविकार इति ॥ हस्त्योष्ठ्यः स्युर् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.16.34.m: Regarding the modification of the shape of the ladles: “They should have lips like an elephant's trunk,” so says Baudhāyana.

20.16.34.s: vāyasapucchā iti śālīkis | ham̐samukhaprasecanā ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
20.16.34.d: वायसपुच्छा इति शालीकिस् । हँसमुखप्रसेचना इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
20.16.34.m: “Like a crow's tail,” so says Śālīki; “Having pouring spouts like a swan's beak,” so says Aupamanyava.

20.16.34.s: ambarīṣasya karaṇa iti || uttarato 'gnyagārasyāmbarīṣaṃ kuryād iti baudhāyanas |
20.16.34.d: अम्बरीषस्य करण इति ॥ उत्तरतो ऽग्न्यगारस्याम्बरीषं कुर्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.16.34.m: Regarding the construction of the frying pan: “He should make the frying pan to the north of the fire-hall,” so says Baudhāyana.

20.16.34.s: yatraivāmbarīṣaḥ syāt tad gacched iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.16.34.d: यत्रैवाम्बरीषः स्यात् तद् गच्छेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.16.34.m: “Wherever the frying pan may be, he should go there,” so says Śālīki.

20.16.34.s: rohite carmaṇīti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | apy arohitam̐ syād iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.16.34.d: रोहिते चर्मणीति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । अप्य् अरोहितँ स्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.16.34.m: Regarding [the rule,] “Upon a red hide”: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana; “It may even not be red,” so says Śālīki.

20.16.34.s: brahmaudanasya mantrāmantra iti || mantravān syād iti baudhāyanas tūṣṇīka iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.16.34.d: ब्रह्मौदनस्य मन्त्रामन्त्र इति ॥ मन्त्रवान् स्याद् इति बौधायनस् तूष्णीक इति शालीकिः ॥
20.16.34.m: Regarding the formula or absence of formula for the rice boiled for priests: “It should have a formula,” so says Baudhāyana; “It should be silent,” so says Śālīki.

20.16.34.s: brahmaudanasya nirvapaṇa iti || pavitravatā pātreṇa mantravantam iti baudhāyanas |
20.16.34.d: ब्रह्मौदनस्य निर्वपण इति ॥ पवित्रवता पात्रेण मन्त्रवन्तम् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.16.34.m: Regarding the measuring out of the rice boiled for priests: “With a vessel having a purifier, accompanied by a formula,” so says Baudhāyana.
“Without a purifier, silently,” so says Śālīki.

20.16.35.s: brahmaudanasya śrapaṇa iti || payasi śrapayed iti baudhāyanas |
20.16.35.d: ब्रह्मौदनस्य श्रपण इति ॥ पयसि श्रपयेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.16.35.m: Regarding the cooking of the rice boiled for priests: “He should cook it in milk,” so says Baudhāyana.

20.16.35.s: naivāsminn āsiñcen na niḥṣiñced iti baudhāyanaḥ kāmam asminn āsiñcen na niḥṣiñced iti śālīkis |
20.16.35.d: नैवास्मिन्न् आसिञ्चेन् न निःषिञ्चेद् इति बौधायनः कामम् अस्मिन्न् आसिञ्चेन् न निःषिञ्चेद् इति शालीकिस् ।
20.16.35.m: “He should neither pour into it nor pour out of it,” so says Baudhāyana; “He may pour into it as he pleases, but not pour out of it,” so says Śālīki.
“Having drained it, it should have soup,” so says Aupamanyava.

20.16.35.s: brahmaudanasyopastaraṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya nopastṛṇīteti śālīkiḥ ||
20.16.35.d: ब्रह्मौदनस्योपस्तरण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य नोपस्तृणीतेति शालीकिः ॥
20.16.35.m: Regarding the under-spreading [of butter] for the rice boiled for priests: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana; “He should not under-spread,” so says Śālīki.

20.16.35.s: brahmaudanasyodavāsana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | atraiva paryupaviśeyur iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.16.35.d: ब्रह्मौदनस्योदवासन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । अत्रैव पर्युपविशेयुर् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.16.35.m: Regarding the removing from the fire of the rice boiled for priests: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana; “They should sit around right there,” so says Śālīki.

20.16.35.s: brahmaudanasyopohana iti || yajño mopanamatu | iti vā tūṣṇīṃ veti
20.16.35.d: ब्रह्मौदनस्योपोहन इति ॥ यज्ञो मोपनमतु । इति वा तूष्णीं वेति
20.16.35.m: Regarding the pushing near of the rice boiled for priests: with “May the sacrifice come to me,” or silently.
The first procedure is that of Baudhāyana; the latter is that of Śālīki.

20.16.35.s: brahmaudanasya prāśana iti || ārṣeyā eva brahmaudanaṃ prāśnīyur iti baudhāyanas |
20.16.35.d: ब्रह्मौदनस्य प्राशन इति ॥ आर्षेया एव ब्रह्मौदनं प्राश्नीयुर् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.16.35.m: Regarding the eating of the rice boiled for priests: “Only descendants of ṛṣis should eat the rice boiled for priests,” so says Baudhāyana.

20.16.35.s: ya eva keca niyatapānā iti kātyas |
20.16.35.d: य एव केच नियतपाना इति कात्यस् ।
20.16.35.m: “Whoever have disciplined drinks,” so says Kātya.

20.16.35.s: atro ha smāhaupamanyavo mahartvija eva brahmaudanaṃ prāśnīyus | atra hy evaite satānunaptriṇo bhavantīti ||
20.16.35.d: अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवो महर्त्विज एव ब्रह्मौदनं प्राश्नीयुस् । अत्र ह्य् एवैते सतानुनप्त्रिणो भवन्तीति ॥
20.16.35.m: Regarding this, Aupamanyava used to say: 'Only the major officiating priests should eat the brahmaudana, for here indeed they become bound by the covenant of Tanūnapāt.'

20.16.36.s: samidhām abhyādhāna iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ sakṛtprāśite 'pratyavamṛṣṭe samidho 'bhyajyādadhyād iti |
20.16.36.d: समिधाम् अभ्याधान इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः सकृत्प्राशिते ऽप्रत्यवमृष्टे समिधो ऽभ्यज्यादध्याद् इति ।
20.16.36.m:
Regarding the placing of the kindling sticks:
The sutra is of Śālīki.
Regarding this, Baudhāyana used to say: 'When [the food] has been eaten once, and not touched again, he should anoint the kindling sticks and place them on [the fire].'

20.16.36.s: atro ha smāhaupamanyavo 'traivaināḥ pārśvataḥ samajya sādayet te yadā sarvaṃ prāśnīyur athaitāṃ pātrīṃ nirṇijyopastīrya yat sthālyām ājyam avaśiṣṭam̐ syāt tat sakṛd abhyunnīya tena samidho 'bhyajyādadhyād iti ||
20.16.36.d: अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवो ऽत्रैवैनाः पार्श्वतः समज्य सादयेत् ते यदा सर्वं प्राश्नीयुर् अथैतां पात्रीं निर्णिज्योपस्तीर्य यत् स्थाल्याम् आज्यम् अवशिष्टँ स्यात् तत् सकृद् अभ्युन्नीय तेन समिधो ऽभ्यज्यादध्याद् इति ॥
20.16.36.m: Regarding this, Aupamanyava used to say: 'Right here at the side, having smeared them together, he should set them down. When they have eaten everything, then, having rinsed this dish and made an under-spread, whatever ghee may remain in the pot, having scooped that up once, he should anoint the kindling sticks with it and place them on [the fire].'

20.16.36.s: goḥ karaṇa iti || kuryād iti baudhāyanas | na kuryād iti śālīkis |
20.16.36.d: गोः करण इति ॥ कुर्याद् इति बौधायनस् । न कुर्याद् इति शालीकिस् ।
20.16.36.m:
Regarding the making of the cow:
'He should make [it],' says Baudhāyana.
'He should not make [it],' says Śālīki.

20.16.36.s: api bahvīr api kurvīta | anu caitasya bhavet puṇyā praśam̐seti kātyaḥ ||
20.16.36.d: अपि बह्वीर् अपि कुर्वीत । अनु चैतस्य भवेत् पुण्या प्रशँसेति कात्यः ॥
20.16.36.m: 'He may even make many, and holy praise should follow this [sacrificer],' says Kātya.

20.16.36.s: araṇyoḥ pradāna iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāhaupamanyavo 'pararātra evāsmā araṇī prayacchet |
20.16.36.d: अरण्योः प्रदान इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवो ऽपररात्र एवास्मा अरणी प्रयच्छेत् ।
20.16.36.m:
Regarding the handing over of the two fire-drills:
The sutra is of the two Teachers.
Regarding this, Aupamanyava used to say: 'In the latter part of the night itself, he should hand over the two fire-drills to him.'

20.16.36.s: varaṃ dadāmīty eva vācaṃ visṛjed iti ||
20.16.36.d: वरं ददामीत्य् एव वाचं विसृजेद् इति ॥
20.16.36.m: 'He should release his speech only [with the words]: "I give a boon."'

20.16.36.s: agnyāyatanānāṃ parilepana iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāhaupamanyavo gārhapatyāyatanam evaikaṃ parilimpet
20.16.36.d: अग्न्यायतनानां परिलेपन इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवो गार्हपत्यायतनम् एवैकं परिलिम्पेत्

20.16.36.s: saṃbhārāṇāṃ nivapana iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāhaupamanyavo gārhapatyāyatana evainān sarvair mantraiḥ pariniṣṭhāpya tredhā nivaped iti ||
20.16.36.d: संभाराणां निवपन इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवो गार्हपत्यायतन एवैनान् सर्वैर् मन्त्रैः परिनिष्ठाप्य त्रेधा निवपेद् इति ॥
20.16.36.m:
Regarding the pouring out of the requisites:
The sutra is of the two Teachers.
Regarding this, Aupamanyava used to say: 'Having prepared them completely in the hearth of the gārhapatya fire itself with all the formulas, he should pour them out in three portions.'

20.17.36.s: idhmasya haraṇa iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano jānudaghne prathamam̐ hared atha nābhidaghne 'tha grīvadaghne
20.17.36.d: इध्मस्य हरण इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो जानुदघ्ने प्रथमँ हरेद् अथ नाभिदघ्ने ऽथ ग्रीवदघ्ने
20.17.36.m:
Regarding the carrying of the kindling wood:
Baudhāyana used to say: 'First he should carry [it] knee-high, then navel-high, then neck-high;
but he should not carry it past the breaths.'

20.17.36.s: ādadāna evaitā mātrā abhisaṃpādayet prāṇām̐s tv eva nātihared iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.17.36.d: आददान एवैता मात्रा अभिसंपादयेत् प्राणाँस् त्व् एव नातिहरेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.17.36.m: 'While taking [it], he should attain these measures, but he should certainly not carry it past the breaths,' says Śālīki.

20.17.37.s: saṃbhārāṇām ākramaṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyana evam evaitena purastāt pratyag āvṛttena dakṣiṇena pūrvapadenottarataḥ pārśvataḥ saṃbhārāṇām ākramayed yathāhitasyāgner aṅgārā abhyavavarterann iti ||
20.17.37.d: संभाराणाम् आक्रमण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायन एवम् एवैतेन पुरस्तात् प्रत्यग् आवृत्तेन दक्षिणेन पूर्वपदेनोत्तरतः पार्श्वतः संभाराणाम् आक्रमयेद् यथाहितस्याग्नेर् अङ्गारा अभ्यववर्तेरन्न् इति ॥
20.17.37.m:
Regarding the stepping upon the requisites:
The sutra is of Śālīki.
Regarding this, Baudhāyana said: 'Just thus, with this [horse] turned westward from the east, with the right front foot, he should make [it] step on the requisites from the northern side, so that the coals of the established fire may roll down.'

20.17.37.s: aśvasya dana iti || adhvaryava etam agnipadam aśvaṃ dadyād anyaṃ brahmaṇa iti baudhāyanas |
20.17.37.d: अश्वस्य दन इति ॥ अध्वर्यव एतम् अग्निपदम् अश्वं दद्याद् अन्यं ब्रह्मण इति बौधायनस् ।
20.17.37.m:
Regarding the giving of the horse:
'He should give this fire-footed horse to the adhvaryu priest, and another to the brahman priest,' says Baudhāyana.

20.17.37.d: एतं ब्रह्मणे ऽन्यम् अध्वर्यव इति शालीकिः ॥
20.17.37.m: 'This [horse] to the brahman priest, another to the adhvaryu priest,' says Śālīki.

20.17.37.s: idhmasya nidhāna iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya tūṣṇīm evedhmaṃ nidadhyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.17.37.d: इध्मस्य निधान इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य तूष्णीम् एवेध्मं निदध्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.17.37.m:
Regarding the laying down of the kindling wood:
The sutra is of Baudhāyana.
'He should lay down the kindling wood silently,' says Śālīki.

20.17.37.s: sabhyāvasathyayoḥ karaṇa iti || kuryād iti baudhāyanas | na kuryād iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.17.37.d: सभ्यावसथ्ययोः करण इति ॥ कुर्याद् इति बौधायनस् । न कुर्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.17.37.m:
Regarding the making of the sabhya and āvasathya fires:
'He should make [them],' says Baudhāyana.
'He should not make [them],' says Śālīki.

20.17.37.s: sabhyāvasathyayor viharaṇa iti || āhavanīyād evainau vihared iti baudhāyanas |
20.17.37.d: सभ्यावसथ्ययोर् विहरण इति ॥ आहवनीयाद् एवैनौ विहरेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.17.37.m:
Regarding the spreading of the sabhya and āvasathya fires:
'He should spread the two from the āhavanīya fire itself,' says Baudhāyana.

20.17.37.s: grāmāgner iti śālīkis | nirmanthyau syātām ity aupamanyavas |
20.17.37.d: ग्रामाग्नेर् इति शालीकिस् । निर्मन्थ्यौ स्याताम् इत्य् औपमन्यवस् ।
20.17.37.m:
'From the village fire,' says Śālīki.
'They should be produced by friction,' says Aupamanyava.

20.17.37.s: atro ha smāhaupamanyavīputraḥ sabhāyām eva sabhyaṃ vyapadiśed āvasatha āvasathīyaṃ parvaṇi cainayo sthālīpākau śrapayitvā brahmaṇe juhuyād iti |
20.17.37.d: अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवीपुत्रः सभायाम् एव सभ्यं व्यपदिशेद् आवसथ आवसथीयं पर्वणि चैनयो स्थालीपाकौ श्रपयित्वा ब्रह्मणे जुहुयाद् इति ।
20.17.37.m: Regarding this, Aupamanyavīputra used to say: 'He should designate the sabhya fire in the assembly hall itself, and the āvasathīya in the dwelling; and having cooked two mess of rice for the two on the junction day, he should sacrifice them to Brahman.'

20.17.37.s: etad api na kuryād ity āñjīgaviḥ ||
20.17.37.d: एतद् अपि न कुर्याद् इत्य् आञ्जीगविः ॥
20.17.37.m: 'He should not do even this,' says Āñjīgavi.

20.17.38.s: rathacakrasya karaṇa iti || kuryād iti baudhāyanas | na kuryād iti śālīkis |
20.17.38.d: रथचक्रस्य करण इति ॥ कुर्याद् इति बौधायनस् । न कुर्याद् इति शालीकिस् ।
20.17.38.m:
Regarding the making of the chariot wheel:
'He should make [it],' says Baudhāyana.
'He should not make [it],' says Śālīki.

20.17.38.s: atro ha smāhaupamanyavo ratham evaitam̐ saṃyuktaṃ prāñcaṃ pravartayet
20.17.38.d: अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवो रथम् एवैतँ संयुक्तं प्राञ्चं प्रवर्तयेत्
20.17.38.m: Regarding this, Aupamanyava used to say: 'He should roll forward this very chariot, yoked, facing east;

20.17.38.s: tam ṛtvigbhyo dadyād iti | etad api na kuryād ity āñjīgaviḥ ||
20.17.38.d: तम् ऋत्विग्भ्यो दद्याद् इति । एतद् अपि न कुर्याद् इत्य् आञ्जीगविः ॥
20.17.38.m:
he should give it to the officiating priests.'
'He should not do even this,' says Āñjīgavi.

20.17.38.s: tanūnām anudeśa iti || pratyadhītyānudiśed iti baudhāyanas |
20.17.38.d: तनूनाम् अनुदेश इति ॥ प्रत्यधीत्यानुदिशेद् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.17.38.m:
Regarding the assigning of the bodies:
'Having recited [the formula] in response, he should assign [them],' says Baudhāyana.

20.17.38.s: yās te agne ghorās tanuvas tābhir amuṃ gaccha | ity eva brūyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.17.38.d: यास् ते अग्ने घोरास् तनुवस् ताभिर् अमुं गच्छ । इत्य् एव ब्रूयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.17.38.m: 'He should only say: "Whatever terrible bodies are yours, O Agni, with those go to so-and-so,"' says Śālīki.

20.17.38.s: virājakrameṣv iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya narya prajāṃ me gopāya | ty eva brūyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.17.38.d: विराजक्रमेष्व् इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य नर्य प्रजां मे गोपाय । त्य् एव ब्रूयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.17.38.m:
Regarding the Virāj steps:
The sutra is of Baudhāyana.
'He should only say: "O manly one, protect my offspring,"' says Śālīki.

20.17.38.s: pūrṇāhutyai havana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya pariśrita eva pūrṇāhutiṃ juhuyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.17.38.d: पूर्णाहुत्यै हवन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य परिश्रित एव पूर्णाहुतिं जुहुयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.17.38.m:
Regarding the offering of the full-offering:
The sutra is of Baudhāyana.
'He should offer the full-offering only while enclosed,' says Śālīki.

20.18.38.s: pūrṇāhutau tūṣṇīm agnihotra iti || sūtram̐ rāthītarāṇām
20.18.38.d: पूर्णाहुतौ तूष्णीम् अग्निहोत्र इति ॥ सूत्रँ राथीतराणाम्
20.18.38.m:
Regarding the full-offering [or] the silent agnihotra:
The sutra is of the Rāthītaras.

20.18.38.s: atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ pūrṇāhutim eva juhuyān na tūṣṇīm agnihotram iti
20.18.38.d: अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः पूर्णाहुतिम् एव जुहुयान् न तूष्णीम् अग्निहोत्रम् इति
20.18.38.m:
Regarding this, Baudhāyana used to say: 'He should offer the full-offering only, not the silent agnihotra.'

'He should offer the silent agnihotra only, not the full-offering,' says Śālīki.

20.18.38.s: tūṣṇīm agnihotram eva juhuyān na pūrṇāhutim iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.18.38.d: तूष्णीम् अग्निहोत्रम् एव जुहुयान् न पूर्णाहुतिम् इति शालीकिः ॥

20.18.38.s: daśahotur vyākhyāna iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano yatra kvaca havir nirvapsyan syāt sāmidhenīr vānuvakṣyan vyācakṣītaiva tatra daśahotāram
20.18.38.d: दशहोतुर् व्याख्यान इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो यत्र क्वच हविर् निर्वप्स्यन् स्यात् सामिधेनीर् वानुवक्ष्यन् व्याचक्षीतैव तत्र दशहोतारम्
20.18.38.m:
Regarding the explanation of the Daśahotṛ formula:
Baudhāyana used to say: 'Wherever he is about to pour out the oblation, or recite the sāmidhenī verses, there he should indeed explain the Daśahotṛ.'

20.18.39.s: ity eṣv evaitad āgnyadheyikeṣu tantreṣu dṛṣṭaṃ bhavatīti śālīkis |
20.18.39.d: इत्य् एष्व् एवैतद् आग्न्यधेयिकेषु तन्त्रेषु दृष्टं भवतीति शालीकिस् ।
20.18.39.m: 'Thus it is seen only in these rituals belonging to the establishment of the fires,' says Śālīki.

20.18.39.s: asminn evaitad āgneye 'ṣṭākapāle dṛṣṭaṃ bhavatīty aupamanyavaḥ ||
20.18.39.d: अस्मिन्न् एवैतद् आग्नेये ऽष्टाकपाले दृष्टं भवतीत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
20.18.39.m: 'It is seen only in this eight-potsherd cake for Agni,' says Aupamanyava.

20.18.39.s: tantrakaraṇa iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ pañcadaśasāmidhenīkāḥ syur vārtraghnāv ājyabhāgāv uccair devatā iti |
20.18.39.d: तन्त्रकरण इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनः पञ्चदशसामिधेनीकाः स्युर् वार्त्रघ्नाव् आज्यभागाव् उच्चैर् देवता इति ।
20.18.39.m:
Regarding the procedure:
Baudhāyana used to say: 'They should have fifteen sāmidhenī verses, the two ghee-portions should be "slayer of Vṛtra" formulas, and the deities [invoked] aloud.'

20.18.39.s: atro ha smāha śālīkiḥ saptadaśasāmidhenīkāḥ syur vṛdhanvantāv ājyabhāgāv upām̐śudevatā iti |
20.18.39.d: अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिः सप्तदशसामिधेनीकाः स्युर् वृधन्वन्ताव् आज्यभागाव् उपाँशुदेवता इति ।
20.18.39.m: Regarding this, Śālīki used to say: 'They should have seventeen sāmidhenī verses, the two ghee-portions should be "increasing" formulas, and the deities [invoked] in a whisper.'

20.18.39.s: atro ha smāhaupamanyava āgneye 'ṣṭākapāle vārtraghnāv ājyabhāgau syātāṃ vṛdhanvantāv aindrāgnādityayo rayimantau puṣṭimantau pavamānahaviḥṣu vītavantāv anvārambheṣṭyām iti ||
20.18.39.d: अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यव आग्नेये ऽष्टाकपाले वार्त्रघ्नाव् आज्यभागौ स्यातां वृधन्वन्ताव् ऐन्द्राग्नादित्ययो रयिमन्तौ पुष्टिमन्तौ पवमानहविःषु वीतवन्ताव् अन्वारम्भेष्ट्याम् इति ॥
20.18.39.m: Regarding this, Aupamanyava used to say: 'For the eight-potsherd cake for Agni, the two ghee-portions should be "slayer of Vṛtra" formulas; for the cake to Indra-Agni and the caru to Aditi, they should be "increasing" formulas; in the pavamāna oblations, they should be "possessing wealth" and "possessing prosperity" formulas; in the introductory offering, they should be "enjoying" formulas.'

20.18.39.s: yājamānasya karaṇa iti || abhīnāmaṃ yājamānaṃ kuryād iti baudhāyanaḥ ||
20.18.39.d: याजमानस्य करण इति ॥ अभीनामं याजमानं कुर्याद् इति बौधायनः ॥
20.18.39.m:
Regarding the performance of the sacrificer's duties:
'He should perform the sacrificer's duties continuously,' says Baudhāyana.
'He should perform the sacrificer's duties according to opportunity,' says Śālīki.

20.18.40.s: dakṣiṇānāṃ dāna iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ sarvā evaitā iṣṭīr dakṣiṇāvatīḥ kuryāt
20.18.40.d: दक्षिणानां दान इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः सर्वा एवैता इष्टीर् दक्षिणावतीः कुर्यात्

20.18.40.s: tisrastisra ekaikasyāṃ dadyān mithunāv uttamāyām iti ||
20.18.40.d: तिस्रस्तिस्र एकैकस्यां दद्यान् मिथुनाव् उत्तमायाम् इति ॥
20.18.40.m: he should give three at each, [and] a pair at the last.'

20.18.40.s: tantarasamāsa iti || nāsti tantrasamāsa ācāryayos | atro ha smāhaupamanyava āgneyo 'ṣṭākapālo 'gnaye pavamānāya tatprathamaṃ tantram̐ syāt |
20.18.40.d: तन्तरसमास इति ॥ नास्ति तन्त्रसमास आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यव आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपालो ऽग्नये पवमानाय तत्प्रथमं तन्त्रँ स्यात् ।

20.18.40.s: athāgnaye pāvakāyāgnaye śucaye tad dvitīyam athaindrāgnaś cādityaś ca carurantaṃ parīyātām iti ||
20.18.40.d: अथाग्नये पावकायाग्नये शुचये तद् द्वितीयम् अथैन्द्राग्नश् चादित्यश् च चरुरन्तं परीयाताम् इति ॥
20.18.40.m: then [the offerings] to Agni Pāvaka and Agni Śuci, that should be the second; then the cake for Indra-Agni and the caru for Aditi should conclude.'

20.18.40.s: dakṣiṇānāṃ dāna iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | ākhyātaṃ baudhāyanasya |
20.18.40.d: दक्षिणानां दान इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । आख्यातं बौधायनस्य ।

20.18.40.s: atro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ sarvā evaitā iṣṭīr dakṣiṇāvatīḥ kuryāc catasraścatasra ekaikasyāṃ dadyān mithunāv uttamāyām iti ||
20.18.40.d: अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवः सर्वा एवैता इष्टीर् दक्षिणावतीः कुर्याच् चतस्रश्चतस्र एकैकस्यां दद्यान् मिथुनाव् उत्तमायाम् इति ॥
20.18.40.m: Regarding this, Aupamanyava used to say: 'He should make all these offerings accompanied by sacrificial fees; he should give four at each, [and] a pair at the last.'

20.18.40.s: ananvārabdhadarśapūrṇamāsasya prāyaścittakaraṇa iti || kuryād iti baudhāyanas |
20.18.40.d: अनन्वारब्धदर्शपूर्णमासस्य प्रायश्चित्तकरण इति ॥ कुर्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.18.40.m:
Regarding the performance of the expiation for one who has not begun the new and full moon rituals:
'He should perform [it],' says Baudhāyana.

20.18.40.s: anvārambheṣṭyām iti || caturhotāram̐ sārasvatau homāv anvārambheṣṭim ity etad upavasathe kuryād athetarad iṣṭyahani kuryād iti baudhāyanas |
20.18.40.d: अन्वारम्भेष्ट्याम् इति ॥ चतुर्होतारँ सारस्वतौ होमाव् अन्वारम्भेष्टिम् इत्य् एतद् उपवसथे कुर्याद् अथेतरद् इष्ट्यहनि कुर्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
20.18.40.m:
Regarding the introductory offering:
'He should perform the Caturhotṛ formula, the two Sārasvata oblations, and the introductory offering on the fast-day; then he should perform the rest on the sacrifice-day,' says Baudhāyana.

20.18.40.s: caturhotāram̐ sārasvatau homāv ity etad upavasthe kuryād athetarad iṣṭyahani kuryād iti śālīkis |
20.18.40.d: चतुर्होतारँ सारस्वतौ होमाव् इत्य् एतद् उपवस्थे कुर्याद् अथेतरद् इष्ट्यहनि कुर्याद् इति शालीकिस् ।
20.18.40.m: 'He should perform the Caturhotṛ formula and the two Sārasvata oblations on the fast-day; then he should perform the rest on the sacrifice-day,' says Śālīki.

20.18.40.s: caturhotāram evopavasathe kuryād athetarad iṣṭyahani kuryād ity aupamanyavaḥ
20.18.40.d: चतुर्होतारम् एवोपवसथे कुर्याद् अथेतरद् इष्ट्यहनि कुर्याद् इत्य् औपमन्यवः
20.18.40.m: "He should perform only the caturhotṛ on the fast-day, and then perform the rest on the day of the sacrifice," says Aupamanyava.

20.18.40.s: sarvam evaitad iṣṭyahani kuryād ity aupamanyavīputraḥ ||
20.18.40.d: सर्वम् एवैतद् इष्ट्यहनि कुर्याद् इत्य् औपमन्यवीपुत्रः ॥
20.18.40.m: "He should perform all of this on the day of the sacrifice itself," says Aupamanyavīputra.

20.19.41.m: Now, therefore, we shall explain the re-establishment [of the sacred fires].

20.19.41.s: sarparājñīṣv iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ sarparājñiyā ṛgbhir gārhapatyam ādadhātīti tam̐ ṣaḍbhir ādhāya saptamyopatiṣṭheteti ||
20.19.41.d: सर्पराज्ञीष्व् इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः सर्पराज्ञिया ऋग्भिर् गार्हपत्यम् आदधातीति तँ षड्भिर् आधाय सप्तम्योपतिष्ठेतेति ॥
20.19.41.m: Regarding the [verses] to the Queen of Serpents: the sūtra is that of Śālīki. Here Baudhāyana used to say: "With the verses of the Queen of Serpents he establishes the gārhapatya fire; having established it with six [verses], he should revere it with the seventh."

20.19.41.s: pūrṇāhutyai karaṇa iti || kuryād iti baudhāyanas | na kuryād iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.19.41.d: पूर्णाहुत्यै करण इति ॥ कुर्याद् इति बौधायनस् । न कुर्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.19.41.m: Regarding the making of the full offering: "He should make it," says Baudhāyana; "he should not make it," says Śālīki.

20.19.41.s: tantrakaraṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyana ubhayāni tantrāṇi kārayet paunarādheyikāni cāgnyādheyikāni ca |
20.19.41.d: तन्त्रकरण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायन उभयानि तन्त्राणि कारयेत् पौनराधेयिकानि चाग्न्याधेयिकानि च ।
20.19.41.m: Regarding the execution of the ritual framework: the sūtra is that of Śālīki. Here Baudhāyana used to say: "He should cause both ritual frameworks to be executed, both those belonging to the re-establishment and those belonging to the establishment of the fires.

20.19.41.d: आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् तस्यासमुदिते ऽग्न्याधेयदक्षिणा दद्यात् ।
20.19.41.m: He should apportion [the cake] on eight potsherds to Agni; while this is not yet completed, he should give the priestly gifts of the establishment of the fires.
Then [the cake] on five potsherds to Agni; while this is not yet completed, he should give the priestly gifts of the re-establishment.
Then the boiled pap to Indra-Agni and to Aditi; then that to Agni-Varuṇa."
Regarding the [sacrifices for] the forms [of Agni] after the twelve days:

20.19.41.s: vibhaktīnāṃ dhāna iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ sarvām̐sarvām ṛcam uktvā yajeteti |
20.19.41.d: विभक्तीनां धान इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः सर्वाँसर्वाम् ऋचम् उक्त्वा यजेतेति ।
20.19.41.m: Regarding the placement of the case-inflections: the sūtra is that of Śālīki. Here Baudhāyana used to say: "Having recited each and every verse, he should sacrifice."

20.19.41.s: āgneyīr dvyakṣarā vibhaktīr dadhyād ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
20.19.41.d: आग्नेयीर् द्व्यक्षरा विभक्तीर् दध्याद् इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
20.19.41.m: "He should place two-syllabled inflections addressed to Agni," says Aupamanyava.

20.19.42.s: puroḍāśasya parihoma iti || daivataṃ parijuhuyād iti baudhāyanaḥ
20.19.42.d: पुरोडाशस्य परिहोम इति ॥ दैवतं परिजुहुयाद् इति बौधायनः
20.19.42.m: Regarding the enclosing offering of the sacrificial cake: "He should make the enclosing offering for the deity," says Baudhāyana.

20.19.42.s: sviṣṭakṛto nirvacana iti || sve sthāne nirbrūyād iti baudhāyanaḥ
20.19.42.d: स्विष्टकृतो निर्वचन इति ॥ स्वे स्थाने निर्ब्रूयाद् इति बौधायनः
20.19.42.m: Regarding the explicit mentioning of Sviṣṭakṛt: "He should mention [him] in his proper place," says Baudhāyana.

20.19.42.s: sve sthāne nirucya kāmaṃ tata ūrdhvaṃ nirbrūyād iti śālīkis |
20.19.42.d: स्वे स्थाने निरुच्य कामं तत ऊर्ध्वं निर्ब्रूयाद् इति शालीकिस् ।
20.19.42.m: "Having mentioned [him] in his proper place, he may at will mention [him] thereafter," says Śālīki.

20.19.42.s: atro ha smāhaupamanyavaḥ pañcaitāni sviṣṭakṛtsthānāni bhavantīti
20.19.42.d: अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवः पञ्चैतानि स्विष्टकृत्स्थानानि भवन्तीति
20.19.42.m: Here Aupamanyava used to say: "There are these five places for Sviṣṭakṛt;
in all of them he should mention [him]."

20.19.42.s: athāpāhṛtāgner naṣṭāraṇīkasya ceti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ kāmaṃ naṣṭeṣu vāpahṛteṣu vāgniṣu nādriyetāgnyādheyam
20.19.42.d: अथापाहृताग्नेर् नष्टारणीकस्य चेति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः कामं नष्टेषु वापहृतेषु वाग्निषु नाद्रियेताग्न्याधेयम्
20.19.42.m: Now, regarding the one whose fires have been carried off and whose churning sticks have been lost: the sūtra is that of Śālīki. Here Baudhāyana used to say: "If the fires are lost or carried off, he need not take account of the establishment of the fires at all.

20.19.42.s: ādhānaprabhṛti yajamāna evāgnayo bhavanti tasya prāṇo gārhapatyo 'pāno 'nvāhāryapacano vyāna āhavanīyaḥ
20.19.42.d: आधानप्रभृति यजमान एवाग्नयो भवन्ति तस्य प्राणो गार्हपत्यो ऽपानो ऽन्वाहार्यपचनो व्यान आहवनीयः
20.19.42.m: From the establishment onwards, the fires are in the sacrificer himself; his in-breath is the gārhapatya fire, his out-breath the anvāhāryapacana fire, his diffused breath the āhavanīya fire.
Having brought them down at will, he should sacrifice."

20.19.42.s: agnīnāṃ viharaṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | ādhānaprabhṛty evaite 'jasrāḥ syur iti śālīkiḥ ||
20.19.42.d: अग्नीनां विहरण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । आधानप्रभृत्य् एवैते ऽजस्राः स्युर् इति शालीकिः ॥
20.19.42.m: Regarding the spreading of the fires: the sūtra is that of Baudhāyana. "From the establishment onwards, these should be continuously burning," says Śālīki.

20.19.42.s: pātrāṇām̐ sādana iti || sūtram̐ śālikes | atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ kūrce vā tṛṇeṣu vā pātrāṇi sādayet |
20.19.42.d: पात्राणाँ सादन इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालिकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः कूर्चे वा तृणेषु वा पात्राणि सादयेत् ।
20.19.42.m: Regarding the setting down of the vessels: the sūtra is that of Śālīki. Here Baudhāyana used to say: "He should set down the vessels either on a grass pad or upon the blades of grass.
Wood being joined with wood becomes south-turned."

20.19.43.s: dvayor homa iti || sa ha smāha baudhāyano yadi pūrvā bhreṣaṃ nīyād uttarayā prāyaścittaṃ kurvīta |
20.19.43.d: द्वयोर् होम इति ॥ स ह स्माह बौधायनो यदि पूर्वा भ्रेषं नीयाद् उत्तरया प्रायश्चित्तं कुर्वीत ।
20.19.43.m: Regarding the offering of the two [libations]: Baudhāyana used to say: "If the first should suffer a mishap, he should perform the expiation with the second.
